text:
Jamie: quick sync — opened a small PR that reorders prefetch vs kv-pop in the shim to avoid a race during fast merges. can someone take a quick look for merge timing concerns? https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4921 :eyes:
Miguel: on it, sending brief review now. is this targeting main or the 1.8-stable branch?
Jamie: main. it should be safe for stable too but want to avoid surprises in canary traffic.
Rachel: quick question — does this change affect batching heuristics or only hotpath ordering?
Jamie: only ordering around `prefetch()` and `kv_pop()` on miss; batching logic untouched. snippet:
```
// old
await prefetch(key);
let v = kv_pop(key);
// new
let v = kv_pop(key);
await prefetch(key);
```
Miguel: saw that — looks fine, but worried about a tiny window where cache-miss path increases tail latency. can we add a micro-benchmark or at least a unit that simulates parallel requests?
Jamie: good call. I'll add a perf unit that fires parallel 8 requests with short seq len. can add before merge.
Sasha: CI flagged a flaky in `batcher_integration_test` on this PR — looks like unrelated timeout but worth a quick retry.
ci-bot: CI: build #4921.2 — failed — batcher_integration_test timeout (rerun suggested)
Jamie: re-triggering CI now.
Miguel: re-review queued, I'll finish after green.
Rachel: fyi if perf micro-bench shows >1% p95 increase then we should hold and discuss fallback order. otherwise LGTM after tests pass. :thumbsup:
Jamie: understood — will post results here when perf job completes.
ci-bot: CI: build #4921.3 — success — all tests passed
Miguel: looked through code — small nit in comment, but functional change is fine. leaving +1.
Sasha: thanks — ran quick local smoke with 50 concurrent requests, no regressions observed. +1 from me.
Jamie: awesome, thanks all. planning to merge in the next 15–30m unless anyone objects. will add the perf unit as a follow-up if timebox runs long. :clock1:
Rachel: no objections from me. merge window ok after green and two approvals.
Jamie: merging now. :merge:
ci-bot: PR #4921 merged into main by Jamie (merge commit 3ac9f8)
Jamie: note: I'll open a follow-up with the micro-bench results and a small comment clean-up. thanks for the quick turnaround everyone! :rocket:
